title: atlas.changes.read.v1 — arguments
description: Read changes after a cursor in total seq order within a feed_epoch. Delivery is at-least-once; deduplicate on change_id. A cursor below the retention floor is a typed refusal naming the re-scan entry point, never a silent empty page.

cursor_seq.description: 0 starts at the beginning of retained history.

feed_epoch.description: Supply the epoch your cursor came from. A mismatch fails loudly instead of resuming into a different total order.

limit.description: Rows on this page. The same transport-invariant cap every paged read uses.

page_size.description: Transport-invariant cap. A transport may not narrow it.
